1.title: Merge Boxes! 2D
1.description: A re-creation of my old Roblox game "Merge Boxes!". It is now also an Incremental game as opposed to just a merge game, and it is also made in Love2D! The game is not finished yet, but I'd say it's pretty close!

2.title: TBB:TARPG
2.description: My most popular game (1M+ visits across all of its places and peak 183 active players at once.), it is roleplay game based off Tumore's game named The Battle Bricks. I made the game private since I no longer wish to associate myself with them, their games, or their community. If you think this game doesn't exist, click here for proof

3.title: Merge Boxes!
3.description: A not-very-popular merge game where you merge boxes.. yup, that's about it. I had a LOT of fun making this game, which is why it is getting a remake (Merge Boxes! 2D)

4.title: mellowestmel.com
4.description: ..the website you're on right now, m8.

5.title: Teapot Tumble
5.description: A remake of Clockwork's "Dodge the Teapots of Doom" (originally released December 15, 2007). Teapot Tumble expands the concept with a shop system, in-game currency, a speedrun timer, and a procedurally generated map that increases in difficulty as more players win.

6.title: Same Day Shipping
6.description: Race against the clock in Same Day Shipping, a fast-paced multiplayer roguelike where every second counts as you rush to deliver packages before time runs out!

7.title: Class Warfare
7.description: Welcome to Class Warfare, a free-for-all fighting game where you battle using different morphs called classes. Each class uses Roblox gear from the catalog.

8.title: Gearbearers
8.description: My newest project, it is a successor to Class Warfare. It is currently private and I do not wish to reveal too much about it yet.

9.title: Slime TD
9.description: A tower defense game where you defend your base against waves of slimes using turrets. Development of this project never got far, since it was my first ever Love2D project. It was abandoned after I came up with the idea for Merge Boxes! 2D.
